Redirect internal users to the Entra OIDC authorize endpoint.

Generates a signed state token to prevent CSRF, then redirects to Entra's
authorize endpoint with the appropriate scopes and redirect URI.

Handle the Entra OIDC callback after user authenticates.

Validates the state parameter, exchanges the authorization code for tokens,
validates the ID token via JWKS, extracts user claims, and issues a session
JWT. Redirects the user to the frontend with the session JWT.
